content:
Hello there Danrosin.


Have your emails not been coming through for a few days? What could be causing this?

Could your inbox be too full? Or is it possible that your antivirus program settings are too strict? You could try lowering the email scanning sensitivity or adding Thunderbird to the exceptions list so it is no longer scanned by the antivirus software.Additionally, are your account settings configured correctly?


Please double-check if everything is exactly right and working properly. Which email provider do you use? Try logging into your webmail (such as Outlook, Gmail, or your provider's own webmail service).

If you can see the emails there, the issue lies with Thunderbird. If you don't see any emails there either, the cause is likely with your provider or the sender.


You may use Troubleshoot Mode to verify whether an active extension or add-on is causing the problem. If this does not appear to be the case, the issue is likely due to your antivirus software. You will need to modify its settings or create an exception for Thunderbird(scan-antivirus). Please click the following link to utilize this tool: https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/troubleshoot-mode-thunderbird
